_comment: Schema reference for backend-only notification_outbox/{eventId}. The document ID is a deterministic semantic event identity. External delivery is at-least-once, never exactly-once.
_invariants: Important customer lifecycle state commits the outbox record transactionally with the domain transition. eventId is deterministic per occurrence and every allowed event has one exact resource/status/payload binding. job_accepted eventId includes offerId to handle the same job accepting a second driver after a pre-tow cancellation; all other events occur at most once per job/refund. providerMessageId/sentAt prove provider acceptance only, not recipient delivery. Payloads are versioned, validated, and contain no customer phone, credentials, secrets, or raw provider bodies.

_event_contract.occurrenceSafetyNote: job_accepted eventId includes offerId because an accepted-driver pre-tow cancellation followed by a second acceptance creates a second legitimate notification occurrence for the same job. All other event types occur at most once per job/refund and use {eventType}:{jobId}.

refund_confirmed.refundAmountPaise: positive safe integer exactly equal to confirmed refund amountPaise

_event_contract.futureEvolution: Any additional event type, resource type, channel, or payload key requires a separately approved schema/version change.
_event_contract.privacy: recipientKey is a validated backend contact reference; payload contains no customer phone, coordinates, driver identity, payment identifier, provider response, credential, or secret.

_recipientKey_contract.resolution: The backend resolves this opaque reference to the customer's validated WhatsApp contact at send time using the stored job document. The key is never a raw phone number or customer PII in this document.
_recipientKey_contract.authorization: recipientKey is never used to authorize Firestore access; it is purely a delivery routing token.

_lastErrorCode_contract.invariant: Only safe operational codes from the allowedCodes list are stored. Raw provider bodies, stack traces, customer data, phone numbers, credentials, and secrets are never stored.

eventId.description: Deterministic per-occurrence semantic event identity. Format per _event_contract.eventIdFormats: job_accepted uses job_accepted:{jobId}:{offerId}; all other events use {eventType}:{jobId}.

resourceType.description: Exact domain resource kind from _event_contract; offers are not customer notification resources.

recipientKey.description: Opaque backend recipient routing token resolved to the customer's validated WhatsApp contact at send time. Never a raw phone number in this document. See _recipientKey_contract.

refundAmountPaise.unit: positive safe integer paise when non-null

payload.description: Exact version-1 envelope governed by _event_contract; no extra keys, phone, secrets, or raw provider response.

lastErrorCode.description: Bounded safe operational code from _lastErrorCode_contract.allowedCodes only. Null when state=sent or before any error. Raw provider bodies, stack traces, credentials, or PII are never stored.

sentAt.description: Provider-acceptance completion timestamp; not proof of delivery.
